newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat mixed, softer on country movement.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat mixed, softer on country movement.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed after a mostly choppy, light-volume session, with traders attributing the market's overall softer tone to light farmer selling.
CBOT wheat was buoyed by lingering optimism over export prospects and traders said this helped support Minneapolis early. But spring wheat weakened late as Atwood/Peavey sold the May contract.
MGE spring wheat ended 3-1/2 cents a bushel lower to one cent higher, with March down 2-1/4 cents at $3.85. Dec lost 3-1/2 cents to close at $4.15-1/2.
"We were fairly light on volumes. We pretty much followed Chicago in the first half and Kansas City in the second half," a trader said. "I think our weakness was due to light country movement."
MGE barley futures did not trade but settled seven cents per cwt lower to two cents higher.
